title: Netlib Repository at UTK and ORNL
summary:
The supplied URL is an HTML landing page for the Netlib repository, not a research paper. It describes Netlib as a collection of mathematical software, papers, and databases, with browsing and search services. ([netlib.org](https://www.netlib.org/))

Because no paper is present at the supplied URL, there is no paper-specific publication date, author list, abstract, or influence to extract. Related Netlib documentation reports that the repository originated in the mid-1980s to distribute mathematical software electronically and later expanded through web access and worldwide mirrors. ([netlib.org](https://www.netlib.org/srwn/srwn21.html)) Netlib subsequently served as an access point for widely used numerical-computing libraries, including LAPACK, and influenced the development of distributed scientific-software repositories such as GAMS. ([netlib.org](https://www.netlib.org/))
